meta.title: Astrocyte 3D culture and bioprinting using peptide functionalized hyaluronan hydrogels.
meta.journal: Science and technology of advanced materials

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: Hyaluronan-PEG hydrogels functionalized with laminin- or RGD-derived peptides were used to culture and bioprint human fetal astrocytes and glioblastoma cells. Peptide choice changed how astrocytes spread and organized.

formulations.review_notes: Print pressure/speed and a viability percentage were not found in the text.
formulations.name: 1% HA:PEG + IKVAV or cRGD peptide
formulations.composition_detail: 1% (w/v) HA-BCN:(PEG-Az)8 with 1 mM peptide (IKVAV or cRGD)
formulations.cell_type: fetal primary astrocytes and U87 glioblastoma cells
formulations.key_outcome: Peptide-functionalized HA hydrogels supported astrocyte culture and could be bioprinted.

evidence.quote: 1.6 million cells/ml of FPA and U87 were encapsulated in 1% HA:PEG hydrogels containing 1 mM of either peptide
All 3D bioprinting was performed using a syringe extrusion printhead on a Cellink BIOX 3D bioprinter (BICO, U.S.A).
